title: EXPLORE RECURRING AFFILIATE PROGRAMS WITH CHATGPT
content:
Some companies offer affiliate compensation that can continue when a referred customer keeps paying for a subscription. That can create recurring affiliate income, but only when the actual program terms provide it.

A SUBSCRIPTION PRODUCT DOES NOT AUTOMATICALLY MEAN RECURRING AFFILIATE COMMISSION
The customer may pay every month while the affiliate receives only the first commission. Another program may pay on renewals for a defined period or while the customer remains attributed. Verify the current terms.

START WITH WHAT YOU WOULD RECOMMEND
A recurring commission is not a reason to recommend a poor-fit product. Define the audience, the ongoing tool or service they genuinely need, and why your recommendation would be useful. Then evaluate programs that fit that relationship.

ATTRIBUTION IS PART OF THE BUSINESS MODEL
Cookie duration, account attribution, last-click rules, renewal commission, cancellation, upgrades, downgrades, refunds, and program termination can all affect what you actually earn. Do not fill these details in from assumptions.

COPY & PASTE INTO CHATGPT

Interview me about a recurring affiliate business direction. Ask who I want to help, what ongoing products or services that audience legitimately uses, what I am qualified or willing to evaluate, how I would add value around the recommendation, and how important recurring commission is to my business model.

Help me build a checklist for evaluating actual affiliate programs. Include initial commission, renewal commission, duration of renewal payments, attribution method, cookie duration where relevant, customer-account attribution, upgrades/downgrades, refunds, payout thresholds, prohibited promotion methods, disclosure requirements, and what happens if the program changes or closes.

Do not invent current program terms or imply that a subscription necessarily pays recurring affiliate commissions. Require verification from current official program terms.

At the end give me:
- Intended audience
- Subscription category
- Why the recommendation is useful
- Value I add beyond the link
- Recurring-income requirement
- Exact program terms to verify
- Risks if attribution or program terms change
- Concise business-direction statement

WHERE TO GO NEXT
If clear, continue to PDF 46. If you discover that recurring affiliate compensation is not necessary, return to PDF 37 and reconsider the broader someone-else's-subscription route.

choices.text: Return to the broader subscription route
